card.title: The Conspiracy Expands
card.instruction: Use every denial, coincidence, and missing detail as proof that more people and higher stakes are involved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our toaster receipt is gone. The shop must have someone inside this house.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I probably recycled it. We can get a copy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So the recycling crew removes originals while the shop prints replacements.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Every shop? Then it's the whole high street. We can't trust a single warranty.

mechanism: A expands a missing-receipt suspicion into a coordinated network by treating ordinary explanations as further evidence.
confusable: Unlike a fixed single culprit, each answer must enlarge both the participants and the perceived stakes.
comparison: A household receipt grows into high-street warranty distrust; the train alternative grows a personal delay into government interference.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
